issues.song_title: Come, Jesus, come We've been waiting so long
issues.text:
And the strong just the same
And all will believe
In the power of His name
issues.prev_text:
There'll be no war,
and there'll be no chains
When Jesus comes
Let today be the day
He'll come for the weak
issues.next_text:
Come, Jesus, come
We've been waiting so long

issues.text:
For faith has caught
this joyful sound
The song of saints on
higher ground.
issues.prev_text:
I want to live above
the world
Tho' satan's darts at me
are hurled
issues.next_text:
Lord, lift me up and let
me stand
By faith on heaven's
table land

issues.text:
But still I'll pray till heaven
I've found
"Lord, lead me on to
higher ground."
issues.prev_text:
I want to scale the
utmost height
And catch a gleam of
glory bright

me stand

issues.text:
Nor could the scroll contain
the whole
Though stretched from sky
to sky
issues.prev_text:
To write the love of
God above
Would drain the ocean dry
issues.next_text:
Oh, love of God, how rich
and pure
How measureless
and strong

issues.text:
And I love that old cross
where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners
was slain
issues.prev_text:
On a hill far away stood
an old rugged cross
The emblem of suffering
and shame
issues.next_text:
So I'll cherish the old
rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I
lay down
